webhooks.name: vagentcard.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for AgentCard resources that enforces two invariants: spec.targetRef must be present, and no two AgentCards in the same namespace may target the same workload (matched by apiVersion, kind, and name). This prevents ambiguous agent-to-workload mappings by rejecting duplicates at admission time via an authoritative API server read.

webhooks.name: mappwrapper.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for AppWrapper resources. The mutating webhook defaults AppWrapper fields on creation, while the validating webhook enforces correctness on create and update by performing SubjectAccessReview checks to verify the submitting user is authorized to create the wrapped resource types, and listing CustomResourceDefinitions to confirm those types exist.

webhooks.name: mraycluster.ray.openshift.ai
webhooks.purpose: Mutates RayCluster resources on create/update to inject an OAuth proxy sidecar container for dashboard authentication and mTLS init containers, volumes, and environment variables for encrypted inter-node communication. The validating webhook ensures these injected components (OAuth proxy, TLS certificates, CA volumes, env vars) are not removed or modified by users, and rejects clusters with enableIngress set to true.

webhooks.name: vappwrapper.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for AppWrapper resources. The mutating webhook defaults AppWrapper fields on creation, while the validating webhook enforces correctness on create and update by performing SubjectAccessReview checks to verify the submitting user is authorized to create the wrapped resource types, and listing CustomResourceDefinitions to confirm those types exist.

webhooks.name: vraycluster.ray.openshift.ai
webhooks.purpose: Mutates RayCluster resources on create/update to inject an OAuth proxy sidecar container for dashboard authentication and mTLS init containers, volumes, and environment variables for encrypted inter-node communication. The validating webhook ensures these injected components (OAuth proxy, TLS certificates, CA volumes, env vars) are not removed or modified by users, and rejects clusters with enableIngress set to true.

webhooks.name: clusterservingruntime.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources on create/update to ensure model format priority consistency (no duplicate priorities across runtimes for the same model format and protocol, and consistent priorities within a single runtime), and validates multi-node worker spec constraints including GPU resource types, parallel size values, blocked environment variables, and disallowing removal of an existing workerSpec.

webhooks.name: inferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.pod-mutator
webhooks.purpose: Mutates pods owned by KServe InferenceServices at creation time, injecting storage initializer init-containers (for model downloading with appropriate credentials), inference logger/batcher agent sidecars, metrics aggregator sidecars, GKE accelerator node selectors, Istio CNI security contexts, and optionally modelcar (OCI image source) volumes. It reads the InferenceService config and credential secrets to configure these injected containers.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.defaulter
webhooks.purpose: Mutating defaulter that applies defaults to LLMInferenceService resources and, when local model caching is enabled in the inference service ConfigMap, lists cluster-scoped LocalModelCache and namespace-scoped LocalModelNamespaceCache resources to find one whose storage URI matches the service's model URI, then stamps matching local-model labels and PVC-name annotations onto the LLMInferenceService (namespace-scoped caches take precedence over cluster-scoped ones).

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for LLMInferenceService v1alpha1 resources on create and update. It enforces cross-field constraints on router/gateway/HTTPRoute configuration, ensures parallelism settings are consistent (e.g., worker requires parallelism, pipeline and data parallelism are mutually exclusive, data and dataLocal must be paired), validates scheduler config (replicas > 0, inline vs ref exclusivity), delegates scaling validation to the v1alpha2 hub type, and prevents mutation of the total parallelism size on updates.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.defaulter
webhooks.purpose: Mutating defaulter that applies defaults to LLMInferenceService resources and, when local model caching is enabled in the inference service ConfigMap, lists cluster-scoped LocalModelCache and namespace-scoped LocalModelNamespaceCache resources to find one whose storage URI matches the service's model URI, then stamps matching local-model labels and PVC-name annotations onto the LLMInferenceService (namespace-scoped caches take precedence over cluster-scoped ones).

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for the LLMInferenceService v1alpha2 custom resource that enforces structural and cross-field constraints on create and update: router/gateway/HTTPRoute consistency, parallelism configuration (pipeline vs data, worker requirements, immutability of total parallelism size), scheduler config (replicas, inline vs ref), LoRA adapter naming (uniqueness, path-traversal prevention, base-model collision), and autoscaling rules (replicas vs scaling mutual exclusivity, HPA/KEDA actuator selection, WVA variantCost format, decode/prefill actuator consistency, KEDA idleReplicaCount bounds).

webhooks.name: llminferenceserviceconfig.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceServiceConfig resources on create and update, ensuring baseRefs is not set (recursive refs are disabled), scheduler replicas are positive if specified, and running any injected controller-level validation. It also emits warnings when well-known configs are modified or deleted.

webhooks.name: llminferenceserviceconfig.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceServiceConfig resources on create and update, rejecting configs that use the forbidden baseRefs field (recursive refs are disabled) or specify invalid scheduler replicas (must be >0), and emits warnings when well-known configs are modified or deleted.

webhooks.name: servingruntime.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources on create/update to ensure model format priority consistency (no duplicate priorities across runtimes for the same model format and protocol, and consistent priorities within a single runtime), and validates multi-node worker spec constraints including GPU resource types, parallel size values, blocked environment variables, and disallowing removal of an existing workerSpec.

webhooks.name: InferenceGraphValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates InferenceGraph resources on create and update, enforcing naming conventions (lowercase alphanumeric/hyphens), the presence of a 'root' node, uniqueness of step names within each node, that each step specifies exactly one inference target (nodeName, serviceName, or serviceURL), and that splitter-type nodes have traffic weights summing to 100.

webhooks.name: InferenceServiceDefaulter-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets sensible defaults on InferenceService objects at create/update time: normalizes legacy deployment-mode annotations, assigns model-serving runtime and protocol versions based on the predictor's model format, applies default resource requests/limits from a central ConfigMap, disables service-account token automount for security, and labels the ISVC for local-model PVC attachment when a matching LocalModelCache or LocalModelNamespaceCache exists.

webhooks.name: InferenceServiceValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for InferenceService resources on create and update, enforcing naming conventions, autoscaler configuration, blocked environment variables, multi-node/workerSpec constraints, canary deployment rules, storage URI formats, scaling metric configurations (HPA/KPA/KEDA), deployment mode immutability, predictor name-change guards, and confidential model serving requirements.

webhooks.name: LocalModelCacheValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates LocalModelCache resources on create, update, and delete. On create/update it enforces that no two LocalModelCache objects share the same storageURI. On delete it prevents removal if any InferenceService or LLMInferenceService still references the cache (checked via the resource's status and the local-model label).

webhooks.name: LocalModelNamespaceCacheValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates LocalModelNamespaceCache resources on create, update, and delete. On create/update, it ensures all referenced NodeGroups exist. On delete, it prevents removal if any InferenceService or LLMInferenceService still references the cache, protecting against orphaning active model serving workloads.

webhooks.name: TrainedModelValidator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates TrainedModel resources on create and update, enforcing that the resource name contains only alphanumeric characters, underscores, or hyphens, that the storageURI uses a supported protocol prefix, and that the memory field is not modified after initial creation.

webhooks.name: clusterservingruntime.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources on create and update, ensuring no two runtimes with the same protocol version share identical model-format priorities (which would make auto-select ambiguous), that each runtime's own repeated model formats carry consistent priorities, and that multi-node WorkerSpec fields (pipeline/tensor parallel sizes, GPU resource types, container count, blocked env vars) are well-formed.

webhooks.name: inferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.pod-mutator
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that intercepts Pod creation for KServe-managed inference pods (identified by the InferenceService pod label). It injects storage initializer init-containers for model downloading, credential volumes/env-vars for accessing model storage, a KServe agent sidecar for request logging and batching, a metrics aggregator sidecar, GKE accelerator node selectors, and optional OCI/modelcar volume mounts—all driven by the InferenceService spec and the cluster-wide inference service ConfigMap.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.defaulter
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that defaults LLMInferenceService resources on create/update by calling SetDefaults and then matching the spec's model URI against existing LocalModelCache and LocalModelNamespaceCache objects to attach local-model labels and annotations (model name, PVC name, source URI), enabling the controller to mount a pre-cached local PVC instead of downloading the model at runtime.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceService v1alpha1 resources on create and update, enforcing structural constraints: router/gateway/HTTPRoute field mutual exclusivity, traffic-splitting field pairing (group+weight) with Gateway API routing, parallelism configuration consistency (worker requires parallelism, pipeline vs data exclusivity, data/dataLocal co-requirement, positive values), scheduler config validity (replicas > 0, inline/ref exclusivity), workload scaling rules (delegated to v1alpha2), and immutability of total parallelism size on updates.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.defaulter
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that defaults LLMInferenceService resources on create/update by calling SetDefaults and then matching the spec's model URI against existing LocalModelCache and LocalModelNamespaceCache objects to attach local-model labels and annotations (model name, PVC name, source URI), enabling the controller to mount a pre-cached local PVC instead of downloading the model at runtime.

webhooks.name: llminferenceservice.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for LLMInferenceService v1alpha2 that rejects invalid create/update requests by enforcing cross-field constraints on router/gateway routing, parallelism (pipeline vs data), scheduler config, LoRA adapter names, autoscaling (WVA with mutually-exclusive HPA/KEDA backends, replica bounds, idle count, variant cost format), KV-cache offloading tiers, managed DRA annotations, confidential model specs, traffic-splitting fields, and immutability of parallelism size on updates.

webhooks.name: llminferenceserviceconfig.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha1.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceServiceConfig resources on create, update, and delete. It forbids the baseRefs field (disabling recursive config references), ensures scheduler replicas are positive when specified, runs optional injected validation logic, and emits warnings or blocks deletion of well-known (built-in) configs.

webhooks.name: llminferenceserviceconfig.kserve-webhook-server.v1alpha2.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LLMInferenceServiceConfig resources on create, update, and delete: forbids the baseRefs field (recursive config references are disabled), ensures scheduler replicas are greater than zero, and warns or blocks modification/deletion of well-known (built-in) configs to protect default system configurations.

webhooks.name: servingruntime.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources on create and update, ensuring no two runtimes with the same protocol version share identical model-format priorities (which would make auto-select ambiguous), that each runtime's own repeated model formats carry consistent priorities, and that multi-node WorkerSpec fields (pipeline/tensor parallel sizes, GPU resource types, container count, blocked env vars) are well-formed.

webhooks.name: notebooks-validation.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates updates to Notebook resources, specifically preventing removal of the MLflow instance annotation while a notebook is running. This guards against a broken state where the MLflow RoleBinding would be deleted immediately but environment variables would persist until pod restart, leaving the MLflow client with credentials but no permissions.

webhooks.name: notebooks.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook for Kubeflow Notebook CRs that injects sidecar containers (kube-rbac-proxy for auth), mounts CA certificate bundles, resolves container images from OpenShift ImageStreams, mounts pipeline runtime ConfigMaps and Elyra/DSPA secrets, injects MLflow tracking environment variables, injects cluster-wide proxy env vars, sets a reconciliation lock annotation on creation, and blocks pod-template-changing mutations on running notebooks (deferring them as pending updates) to prevent unintended pod restarts.

webhooks.name: mraycluster.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that defaults RayCluster resources on create/update. On OpenShift clusters (detected via Route API discovery), it enforces secure trusted networking by setting the EnableSecureTrustedNetwork annotation to true and forcibly disables EnableIngress to ensure all access goes through Gateway API authentication rather than direct Routes/Ingress. On non-OpenShift clusters it sets the annotation to false.

webhooks.name: mraycluster.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that defaults RayCluster resources on create/update. On OpenShift clusters (detected via Route API discovery), it enforces secure trusted networking by setting the EnableSecureTrustedNetwork annotation to true and forcibly disables EnableIngress to ensure all access goes through Gateway API authentication rather than direct Routes/Ingress. On non-OpenShift clusters it sets the annotation to false.

webhooks.name: vraycluster.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates RayCluster resources on create and update, ensuring the cluster metadata name is valid and that all worker group names within the spec are unique.

webhooks.name: vrayjob.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for RayJob resources that rejects create and update requests whose metadata (specifically the object name) fails RayJob-specific naming rules enforced by ValidateRayJobMetadata. Delete requests are always allowed without validation.

webhooks.name: vrayservice.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for RayService resources that rejects create and update requests whose metadata (specifically the object name) fails RayService-specific naming rules enforced by ValidateRayServiceMetadata. Delete requests are always allowed.

webhooks.name: ClusterQueueWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Defaults and validates ClusterQueue resources. The mutating webhook adds a ResourceInUse finalizer on creation, while the validating webhook enforces correctness of resource groups (no duplicate resources or flavors, non-negative quantities), borrowing/lending limits (must be nil when no cohort, lending must not exceed nominal quota), namespace selector labels, admission check configuration (disallows setting both AdmissionChecks and AdmissionChecksStrategy), preemption policy consistency, and fair sharing settings.

webhooks.name: ClusterQueueWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Defaults and validates ClusterQueue resources. The mutating webhook adds a ResourceInUse finalizer on creation, while the validating webhook enforces correctness of resource groups (no duplicate resources or flavors, non-negative quantities), borrowing/lending limits (must be nil when no cohort, lending must not exceed nominal quota), namespace selector labels, admission check configuration (disallows setting both AdmissionChecks and AdmissionChecksStrategy), preemption policy consistency, and fair sharing settings.

webhooks.name: JobSetWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for JobSet resources that defaults suspension state (suspending jobs managed by Kueue), assigns a default local queue label, defaults the managedBy field for MultiKueue, and validates queue-name immutability, topology requests on replicated jobs, and standard Kueue job constraints on create and update.

webhooks.name: JobSetWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for JobSet resources that defaults suspension state (suspending jobs managed by Kueue), assigns a default local queue label, defaults the managedBy field for MultiKueue, and validates queue-name immutability, topology requests on replicated jobs, and standard Kueue job constraints on create and update.

webhooks.name: JobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for batch/v1 Jobs that integrates them with Kueue's queue-based job scheduling. The mutating webhook defaults the local queue label, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (based on queue name or namespace selector), and sets the managedBy field for MultiKueue. The validating webhook enforces correctness of partial admission (minParallelism annotation), sync-completion (completions-equal-parallelism annotation), and topology-aware scheduling annotations on create and update.

webhooks.name: JobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for batch/v1 Jobs that integrates them with Kueue's queue-based job scheduling. The mutating webhook defaults the local queue label, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (based on queue name or namespace selector), and sets the managedBy field for MultiKueue. The validating webhook enforces correctness of partial admission (minParallelism annotation), sync-completion (completions-equal-parallelism annotation), and topology-aware scheduling annotations on create and update.

webhooks.name: MpiJobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for Kubeflow MPIJob resources integrated with Kueue. The mutating webhook applies default queue names, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (based on queue annotation, namespace selector, or parent ownership), and sets the managedBy field. The validating webhook enforces Kueue-specific constraints on create and update, including topology-aware scheduling (TAS) pod set request validation for each MPI replica spec.

webhooks.name: MpiJobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for Kubeflow MPIJob resources integrated with Kueue. The mutating webhook applies default queue names, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (based on queue annotation, namespace selector, or parent ownership), and sets the managedBy field. The validating webhook enforces Kueue-specific constraints on create and update, including topology-aware scheduling (TAS) pod set request validation for each MPI replica spec.

webhooks.name: Pod-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for Pods managed by Kueue. On creation, it determines whether a pod should be managed by Kueue based on namespace selectors, pod selectors, queue name labels, and ancestor job ownership; if so, it adds the managed-by-kueue label, a finalizer, and a scheduling gate to suspend the pod until a Kueue workload admits it. It also validates pod group metadata consistency (group name and total count), topology-aware scheduling annotations, managed label values, and prebuilt workload naming on both create and update.

webhooks.name: PodWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for Pods managed by Kueue. On creation, it determines whether a pod should be managed by Kueue based on namespace selectors, pod selectors, queue name labels, and ancestor job ownership; if so, it adds the managed-by-kueue label, a finalizer, and a scheduling gate to suspend the pod until a Kueue workload admits it. It also validates pod group metadata consistency (group name and total count), topology-aware scheduling annotations, managed label values, and prebuilt workload naming on both create and update.

webhooks.name: RayClusterWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Defaults and validates KubeRay RayCluster resources for Kueue integration. The mutating webhook assigns a default local queue, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (checking ancestor ownership and namespace selectors), and sets the managedBy annotation. The validating webhook ensures autoscaling is disabled, worker group count does not exceed 7, no worker group is named 'head', and topology-aware scheduling requests are well-formed.

webhooks.name: RayClusterWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Defaults and validates KubeRay RayCluster resources for Kueue integration. The mutating webhook assigns a default local queue, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (checking ancestor ownership and namespace selectors), and sets the managedBy annotation. The validating webhook ensures autoscaling is disabled, worker group count does not exceed 7, no worker group is named 'head', and topology-aware scheduling requests are well-formed.

webhooks.name: RayJobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutates and validates RayJob resources for Kueue integration: the mutating webhook applies a default local queue, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (checking for ancestor Kueue-managed jobs and namespace selectors), and sets default managedBy; the validating webhook enforces that Kueue-managed RayJobs shut down their cluster after finishing, do not reference existing clusters, disable autoscaling, have at most 7 worker groups with no group named 'head', and pass topology-aware scheduling request validation.

webhooks.name: RayJobWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutates and validates RayJob resources for Kueue integration: the mutating webhook applies a default local queue, suspends jobs that should be managed by Kueue (checking for ancestor Kueue-managed jobs and namespace selectors), and sets default managedBy; the validating webhook enforces that Kueue-managed RayJobs shut down their cluster after finishing, do not reference existing clusters, disable autoscaling, have at most 7 worker groups with no group named 'head', and pass topology-aware scheduling request validation.

webhooks.name: ResourceFlavorWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates and defaults Kueue ResourceFlavor objects. On creation, it adds a ResourceInUse finalizer to prevent premature deletion. On create and update, it validates node labels, node taints (ensuring uniqueness by key and effect), and tolerations.

webhooks.name: ResourceFlavorWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates and defaults Kueue ResourceFlavor objects. On creation, it adds a ResourceInUse finalizer to prevent premature deletion. On create and update, it validates node labels, node taints (ensuring uniqueness by key and effect), and tolerations.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for apps/v1 Deployments managed by Kueue. The mutating webhook applies a default local queue label, walks the owner chain to detect if an ancestor job is already Kueue-managed, and if the workload should be suspended it annotates the pod template with a suspended-by-parent marker, sets Kueue-managed labels, and propagates queue-name and priority-class labels to pods. The validating webhook ensures the queue-name label is well-formed on create, and on update prevents changing or removing the queue-name while ready replicas exist and validates immutability of the workload priority class.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for StatefulSets managed by Kueue. The defaulter propagates queue-name labels and pod-group annotations into the pod template and suspends workloads that should be managed by Kueue, while the validator enforces queue-name immutability when pods are running, prevents pod-spec changes on managed workloads, and restricts replica scaling to only scale-to-zero or scale-from-zero.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for LeaderWorkerSet resources managed by Kueue. The defaulter suspends incoming LeaderWorkerSets that should be queue-managed (applying default local queue, injecting priority-class labels and pod-group annotations into leader/worker pod templates), while the validator enforces queue-name validity, topology-aware scheduling annotations, and immutability of queue name, priority class, and pod specs on updates for Kueue-managed workloads.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for LeaderWorkerSet resources managed by Kueue. The defaulter suspends incoming LeaderWorkerSets that should be queue-managed (applying default local queue, injecting priority-class labels and pod-group annotations into leader/worker pod templates), while the validator enforces queue-name validity, topology-aware scheduling annotations, and immutability of queue name, priority class, and pod specs on updates for Kueue-managed workloads.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating webhook for StatefulSets managed by Kueue. The defaulter propagates queue-name labels and pod-group annotations into the pod template and suspends workloads that should be managed by Kueue, while the validator enforces queue-name immutability when pods are running, prevents pod-spec changes on managed workloads, and restricts replica scaling to only scale-to-zero or scale-from-zero.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for apps/v1 Deployments managed by Kueue. The mutating webhook applies a default local queue label, walks the owner chain to detect if an ancestor job is already Kueue-managed, and if the workload should be suspended it annotates the pod template with a suspended-by-parent marker, sets Kueue-managed labels, and propagates queue-name and priority-class labels to pods. The validating webhook ensures the queue-name label is well-formed on create, and on update prevents changing or removing the queue-name while ready replicas exist and validates immutability of the workload priority class.

webhooks.name: WorkloadWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for Kueue Workload resources. The defaulter strips minCount from pod sets when the PartialAdmission feature gate is disabled, while the validator enforces structural rules on pod sets (e.g., disallowing the reserved 'pods' resource key), checks admission assignment consistency with declared pod sets, validates reclaimable pod counts, validates admission-check pod-set updates, and ensures immutability of podSets and admission fields once a workload holds a quota reservation.

webhooks.name: WorkloadWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating and validating admission webhook for Kueue Workload resources. The defaulter strips minCount from pod sets when the PartialAdmission feature gate is disabled, while the validator enforces structural rules on pod sets (e.g., disallowing the reserved 'pods' resource key), checks admission assignment consistency with declared pod sets, validates reclaimable pod counts, validates admission-check pod-set updates, and ensures immutability of podSets and admission fields once a workload holds a quota reservation.

webhooks.name: vcohort.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates Cohort resources on create and update by checking the spec's fairSharing and resourceGroups fields against validation rules, ensuring cohort configurations are well-formed before being persisted.

webhooks.name: mmodelregistry.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default values on ModelRegistry CRs, and validating webhook that enforces cluster-wide name uniqueness on create and validates the registry spec (database config, TLS, etc.) on create and update.

webhooks.name: vmodelregistry.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default values on ModelRegistry CRs, and validating webhook that enforces cluster-wide name uniqueness on create and validates the registry spec (database config, TLS, etc.) on create and update.

webhooks.name: servingruntime.modelmesh-webhook-server.default
webhooks.purpose: Validates ServingRuntime and ClusterServingRuntime resources on create/update for ModelMesh-compatible (multi-model) runtimes, ensuring that autoscaler configuration annotations are well-formed: the autoscaler class is supported, HPA metrics are valid, target utilization percentage is a 1-100 integer, min/max replica bounds are consistent, and that spec.replicas is not set when HPA autoscaling is enabled.

webhooks.name: vaitenant.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for AITenant resources that enforces two invariants: AITenant CRs must be created in the configured infrastructure namespace, and each AITenant must reference a unique Gateway (no two AITenants may share the same gateway name/namespace pair) to guarantee tenant isolation.

webhooks.name: vmaasauthpolicy.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for MaaSAuthPolicy creation that ensures the target namespace is an initialized MaaS tenant namespace. It rejects creation if neither a MaasTenantConfig nor a legacy Tenant CR exists in the namespace, preventing auth policies from being created in namespaces that have not been properly onboarded as tenants.

webhooks.name: vmaassubscription.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook that rejects creation of MaaSSubscription resources in namespaces that have not been initialized as MaaS tenants. On create, it checks whether a MaasTenantConfig (or legacy Tenant) CR exists in the target namespace, denying the request if neither is found.

webhooks.name: connection-llmisvc-v1alpha1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook for LLMInferenceService resources (v1alpha1 and v1alpha2) that performs two tasks: (1) injects or cleans up ConnectionsAPI credentials (S3 service-account + model URI, HTTPS/URI model URI, or OCI imagePullSecrets) based on a connection annotation on the resource, and (2) resolves the referenced HardwareProfile CR to inject container resource limits, nodeSelector, tolerations, and Kueue queue labels into the pod template.

webhooks.name: connection-llmisvc-v1alpha2.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook for LLMInferenceService resources (v1alpha1 and v1alpha2) that performs two tasks: (1) injects or cleans up ConnectionsAPI credentials (S3 service-account + model URI, HTTPS/URI model URI, or OCI imagePullSecrets) based on a connection annotation on the resource, and (2) resolves the referenced HardwareProfile CR to inject container resource limits, nodeSelector, tolerations, and Kueue queue labels into the pod template.

webhooks.name: minferencegraph-v1alpha1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates InferenceGraph resources on create and update to ensure that serviceURLs in graph node steps reference only cluster-internal services within the same namespace as the InferenceGraph, rejecting public hostnames and cross-namespace references to prevent security issues like authorization header leakage. The mutating defaulter is a no-op placeholder.

webhooks.name: minferenceservice-v1beta1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates that InferenceService resources are not created in the protected application namespace and enforces name-length limits, then mutates create/update requests by injecting connection credentials (S3 storage keys, URI storageUri, OCI imagePullSecrets) from referenced Secrets and applying HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue label) into the InferenceService spec. On updates it handles cleanup when connections or hardware profiles are removed or replaced.

webhooks.name: mutating.pod.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutates newly created Pods that have RAY_USE_TLS enabled on their kserve-container or worker-container by injecting TLS-related volumes, volume mounts, and an init container that copies Ray TLS certificates from a shared secret into the pod, enabling mTLS communication between Ray cluster nodes used for distributed inference.

webhooks.name: validating.isvc.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates that InferenceService resources are not created in the protected application namespace and enforces name-length limits, then mutates create/update requests by injecting connection credentials (S3 storage keys, URI storageUri, OCI imagePullSecrets) from referenced Secrets and applying HardwareProfile scheduling stanzas (container resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, Kueue queue label) into the InferenceService spec. On updates it handles cleanup when connections or hardware profiles are removed or replaced.

webhooks.name: validating.nim.account.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates NIM Account creation by enforcing a singleton constraint: only one Account resource is allowed per namespace. Update and delete operations are always permitted without validation.

webhooks.name: vinferencegraph-v1alpha1.odh-model-controller.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates InferenceGraph resources on create and update to ensure that serviceURLs in graph node steps reference only cluster-internal services within the same namespace as the InferenceGraph, rejecting public hostnames and cross-namespace references to prevent security issues like authorization header leakage. The mutating defaulter is a no-op placeholder.

webhooks.name: vogxserver.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for OGXServer create/update that enforces distribution name validity against the operator's known registry, provider ID uniqueness, model-to-provider reference integrity, and rejects adoption annotations whose value equals the CR name (which would cause Deployment name conflicts). It also emits deprecation warnings for renamed distributions.

webhooks.name: Defaulter-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default values on DataScienceCluster v1 resources during create/update. When ModelRegistry is Managed and RegistriesNamespace is empty, it defaults the namespace; when Kserve is Managed and NIM's ManagementState is empty, it defaults NIM to Managed.

webhooks.name: Defaulter-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default field values on DataScienceCluster v2 resources during create/update: when ModelRegistry is Managed and RegistriesNamespace is empty it fills in the default namespace, and when Kserve is Managed and NIM's ManagementState is empty it defaults NIM to Managed.

webhooks.name: Injector-webhook
webhooks.enable_condition: Kserve component enabled OR Workbenches component enabled
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that intercepts create/update of Notebooks, InferenceServices, and LLMInferenceServices to inject hardware profile settings (resource requirements, node selectors, tolerations) from a referenced HardwareProfile CR specified via annotations. It handles profile switching (clearing old settings before applying new ones), profile removal (cleaning up injected settings), container name validation, and merges scheduling configuration while preserving user-specified values.

webhooks.name: Injector-webhook
webhooks.enable_condition: MonitoringServiceName component enabled OR MonitoringServiceName component enabled
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that automatically injects the monitoring scrape label (monitoring.opendatahub.io/scrape=true) into ServiceMonitor and PodMonitor resources on create/update, but only when the resource's namespace is labeled for ODH monitoring and the cluster-scoped Monitoring CR exists (indicating monitoring is enabled).

webhooks.name: NotebookWebhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook for Kubeflow Notebook CRs that validates and injects 'platform connection' secrets. On create/update, it parses the opendatahub.io/connections annotation (a comma-separated list of namespace/name secret references), verifies each referenced Secret exists and that the requesting user has RBAC permission to get it (via SubjectAccessReview), then patches the notebook's first container envFrom to add or remove secretRef entries corresponding to added or removed connections.

webhooks.name: Validator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates DSCInitialization v1 resources by enforcing singleton semantics (only one instance allowed), validating PEM format of customCABundle when TrustedCABundle is Managed, and preventing deletion while a DataScienceCluster object still exists.

webhooks.name: Validator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates DataScienceCluster v1 create and update requests: enforces singleton creation (only one DSC allowed), denies Kueue managementState=Managed, prevents v1 API updates when v2-only components are Managed (to avoid silent data loss during v1-to-v2 conversion), and warns when the deprecated kserve.modelsAsService field is Managed.

webhooks.name: Validator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates DataScienceCluster v2 resources on create and update. Enforces singleton semantics (only one DSC instance allowed), denies Kueue with ManagementState=Managed (no longer supported), and emits a deprecation warning when the kserve.modelsAsService field is set to Managed.

webhooks.name: Validator-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validates DSCInitialization v2 resources by enforcing singleton creation (only one instance allowed), validating PEM format of customCABundle when TrustedCABundle is managed, and preventing deletion while any DataScienceCluster object still exists.

webhooks.name: mutate-pod.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that intercepts Pod creation requests in configured Spark job namespaces, looks up the owning SparkApplication, and defaults the pod spec with settings from the SparkApplication CR — including volumes, environment variables, config maps, affinity, tolerations, node selectors, security contexts, GPU resources, sidecar/init containers, ports, owner references, memory limits, and scheduling configuration for both driver and executor pods.

webhooks.name: mutate-scheduledsparkapplication.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating admission webhook that sets default values on ScheduledSparkApplication resources during create and update operations. Currently a no-op placeholder that only logs the mutation request; concrete defaulting logic (e.g., applying scheme defaults) is deferred to a future implementation.

webhooks.name: mutate-sparkapplication.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default values on SparkApplication resources during create/update. It only applies defaults (via the operator's webhook scheme) when the application is in a 'New' or 'Invalidating' state, ensuring defaults are re-applied when a spec is first submitted or being revalidated after changes.

webhooks.name: mutate-sparkconnect.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that sets default field values on SparkConnect resources during create and update operations. It applies scheme-registered defaults via operatorscheme.WebhookScheme.Default, ensuring all SparkConnect objects have consistent baseline values before they are persisted.

webhooks.name: validate-scheduledsparkapplication.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates ScheduledSparkApplication resources on create and update, ensuring the metadata.name is a valid DNS-1035 label (to prevent downstream Service creation failures) and that the embedded SparkApplication template's sparkConf is valid.

webhooks.name: validate-sparkapplication.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates SparkApplication resources on create and update by enforcing DNS-1035 naming, Spark version constraints for pod templates, non-conflicting node selectors and driver ingress options, spark conf validation, and optionally checking that requested resources fit within namespace ResourceQuotas.

webhooks.name: validate-sparkconnect.sparkoperator.k8s.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates SparkConnect custom resources on create and update, enforcing that the metadata name is a valid DNS-1035 label (short enough for derived Service names), that a Spark version is specified (3.0.0+ when pod templates are used), that container images are available either at the spec level or in both server and executor pod templates, that dynamic allocation executor bounds are consistent and non-negative, that memory strings use valid Spark/Java format, and that sparkConf does not contain denied keys managed by the operator.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for JAXJob resources that enforces structural correctness on create and update: the job name must be a DNS-1035 label, replica specs must exist and only use the 'Worker' replica type, every container must have an image, and at least one container must be named 'jax'.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for PaddleJob resources that enforces naming conventions (DNS-1035 labels), RunPolicy validity, and replica spec constraints on create and update. It ensures each replica type is either Master or Worker, that containers are present with images specified, and that at least one container is named 'paddle'.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for PyTorchJob resources that enforces structural correctness on create and update: the job name must be a DNS-1035 label, replica specs must only use Master or Worker types, every replica must contain at least one container named 'pytorch' with an image set, Master replicas must be exactly 1, and elastic-policy constraints (e.g., deprecated nProcPerNode vs nprocPerNode) are checked. It also validates RunPolicy fields and prevents forbidden RunPolicy mutations on update.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for TFJob resources that enforces structural correctness on create and update: the job name must be a DNS-1035 label, tfReplicaSpecs must be present with at least one container per replica that includes an image and a container named 'tensorflow', at most one Chief or Master replica type is allowed, and RunPolicy immutability/validity rules are checked on updates.

webhooks.name: Webhook-webhook
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for XGBoostJob resources that enforces structural constraints on create and update: the job name must be a DNS-1035 label, replica specs must include a Master replica with exactly 1 replica, only Master and Worker replica types are allowed, every container must have an image, and at least one container must be named 'xgboost'.

webhooks.name: connection-notebook.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that intercepts Notebook (kubeflow.org/v1) create and update requests, parses the opendatahub.io/connections annotation to resolve referenced Secrets, validates they exist in the notebook's namespace and the requesting user has 'get' permission on them via SubjectAccessReview, then injects or removes those secrets as envFrom entries in the notebook's first container.

webhooks.name: hardwareprofile-notebook-injector.opendatahub.io
webhooks.purpose: Mutating webhook that intercepts Notebook create/update requests and injects hardware profile settings (resource requests/limits, node selectors, and tolerations) from a referenced HardwareProfile CR into the notebook's pod template. On profile changes or removal, it cleans up previously applied scheduling settings to ensure the notebook reflects the currently referenced (or no) hardware profile.

webhooks.name: vagentruntime.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for AgentRuntime resources that enforces three invariants on create/update: no two AgentRuntimes in the same namespace may target the same workload (apiVersion+kind+name), tlsBridgeMode=enabled is only allowed with proxy-sidecar or lite authBridgeModes, and mTLS mode must be compatible with the chosen authBridgeMode (currently all combinations are accepted but the gate exists for future restrictions).

webhooks.name: vworkspace.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating admission webhook for Workspace resources on create and update. It fetches the referenced WorkspaceKind to ensure the Workspace's selected imageConfig and podConfig IDs exist in that WorkspaceKind's allowed values, and validates pod template metadata (labels and annotations) against Kubernetes naming rules.

webhooks.name: vworkspacekind.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validates WorkspaceKind resources on create, update, and delete: on create it validates pod metadata, environment variables, imageConfig/podConfig values (including port references and redirect cycles), and default selections; on update it incrementally re-validates only changed options while preventing in-use options from being removed or having their specs altered, and re-checks redirect graphs when redirects change; on delete it blocks removal if any Workspaces still reference the WorkspaceKind or if a protection finalizer is present.

webhooks.name: localmodelnamespacecache.kserve-webhook-server.validator
webhooks.purpose: Validates LocalModelNamespaceCache resources on create, update, and delete. On create/update, it ensures all referenced node groups exist; on delete, it prevents removal if the cache is still referenced by any InferenceService or LLMInferenceService via matching local-model labels.

webhooks.name: vworkspace.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for Workspace resources on create and update. It ensures the referenced WorkspaceKind exists, that the selected imageConfig and podConfig IDs are valid options defined in that WorkspaceKind, and that pod template metadata (labels and annotations) are well-formed.

webhooks.name: vworkspacekind.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for WorkspaceKind resources (kubeflow.org/v1beta1) that enforces spec correctness on create (ports, imageConfig/podConfig values, redirects, defaults, env vars, labels, annotations), immutability of in-use options on update (preventing changes or removal of imageConfig/podConfig values actively referenced by Workspaces), and deletion protection when Workspaces still reference the WorkspaceKind or a protection finalizer is present.

webhooks.name: validator.clustertrainingruntime.trainer.kubeflow.org
webhooks.purpose: Validates ClusterTrainingRuntime resources on create and update by ensuring the replicated jobs in the runtime spec are well-formed, and emits a deprecation warning on create if the runtime is marked as deprecated via labels.

webhooks.name: validator.trainjob.trainer.kubeflow.org
webhooks.purpose: Validates TrainJob resources on create and update by resolving the referenced runtime (e.g., ClusterTrainingRuntime) from an in-memory registry and delegating validation to that runtime's ValidateObjects method, rejecting requests that reference an unsupported runtime.

webhooks.name: validator.trainingruntime.trainer.kubeflow.org
webhooks.purpose: Validates TrainingRuntime resources on create to ensure that replicated jobs with ancestor labels (trainer, model-initializer, dataset-initializer) always have exactly 1 replica and contain the required named container for that ancestor role (e.g., 'node' for trainer, 'model-initializer' for model-initializer, 'dataset-initializer' for dataset-initializer).
